correctness.rationale: Inspected all 103 explicit tetrahedra in frozen verify.py; independently transcribed/reconstructed the 17 vertices, 120 graph edges, 206 triangular faces, 467 graph 3-cliques and 261 nonfacial cycles. Computed an independent integral 206×104 relation matrix after spanning-tree collapse; SymPy Smith normal form gave exactly 101 ones, one 2, two zeros, proving H1≅Z²⊕Z/2. Independent row-space reductions modulo 2 and 101 detected all 261 nonfacial triangle classes as nonzero; 205 are nonzero mod both and 56 detectable mod2 only. Audited explicit integral Y1,Y2 and mod2 W cocycle lists and three coordinate-generating triangle witnesses in the source, which support its complete seven-type distribution 56+35+34+34+34+37+31=261 and primitive free projections. These modular checks corroborate essentiality, not independently determine the exact coordinate multiplicities without the explicit source cocycle computation; the integral Smith proof and source cocycle certification jointly establish the final claim. Any simple graph cycle has at least three edges, so systole length is 3.
residual_risks: An unindexed earlier computational homology census of the exact triangulation may exist.
The basis g1,g2 is explicitly certified but not geometrically canonical; only primitive shell shape invariant modulo change of basis.
Independent modular checks prove essentiality and Smith type; exact seven-type class distribution additionally depends on inspected explicit cocycle and orientation conventions.
The result is a particular labelled triangulation, not all triangulations or geometric systoles.
